items.source: Declare a join condition in one step. Using conditions allows more flexibility in comparison to on(Expression) which only allows for equality comparisons chained together with AND.
items.translation: 一步声明一个condition连接。使用条件相较于仅允许通过AND链式连接的等值比较的on(Expression)，提供了更高的灵活性。

items.source: Interface exposing ON methods to declare JOIN relationships.
items.translation: 暴露 `ON` 方法以声明 `JOIN` 关系的接口。

items.source: Declare a join condition in one step.
items.translation: 在一行中声明一个condition连接。

items.source: column - the source column, must not be null or empty.
items.translation: column - 源列，不能为空或空字符串。

items.source: Mark Paluch, Jens Schauder, Myeonghyeon Lee
